notes: Update helper now opens in its own window - automatic updates fixed
patch_notes: Found by Ariya's test (Nov 22, 2026): the app closed on Update but nothing else happened. The update helper was launched without a console window, and on his PC the batch died silently right after its first log line - while the very same file run by hand worked perfectly. The helper now launches with its own console window, exactly like a manual double-click. Note: to land on this version, click Update, let the app close, then double-click finish_update.bat in the project folder once - from the next update on, everything is automatic.
